// The set of spatial contacts between one body pair in one step. BodyA and
// BodyB are zero-based body indices (-1 = none); Normal is the shared contact
// normal from A toward B; Friction is the combined dimensionless friction
// coefficient; Restitution is the combined bounciness in [0, 1].
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coefficient_of_restitution)
type ContactManifold3D
    implements IValue
{
    BodyA: BodyIndex;
    BodyB: BodyIndex;
    Points: Array<ContactPoint3D>;
    Normal: Direction3D;
    Friction: Number;
    Restitution: Proportion;
}
